[{{< meta record-label >}} · {{< meta institution >}} · {{< meta year >}}]{.eyebrow}

This thesis studies the limiting behaviour of partial sums of residuals from ARMAX models, focusing on ARMA processes with polynomial deterministic trends and unit roots. It develops a structural break test statistic for settings where trends and unit roots may coexist. Simulated and real datasets illustrate the behaviour of the test.
